Position: DevOps Engineer / Sr. DevOps Engineer

Job Location: Gurgaon




Professional Experience

3-6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or related roles.
Proven experience in designing, deploying, and managing cloud environments on AWS and Azure.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, infrastructure management, and deployment practices.



Key Responsibilities



Cloud Infrastructure Management
Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available cloud environments on AWS and Azure.
Leverage cloud-native services such as AWS ECS/EKS and Azure AKS to deploy and manage containerized applications.
Optimize cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.


CI/CD Pipeline Development
Build, configure, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, and other automation tools.
Collaborate with development teams to integrate code quality, testing, and security checks into the deployment lifecycle.
Automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes.


Containerization & Orchestration
Deploy, configure, and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
Implement best practices for container orchestration, scalability, availability, and resource utilization.
Troubleshoot container and Kubernetes-related issues across development and production environments.


Monitoring & Troubleshooting
Implement and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system reliability and performance.
Monitor infrastructure, applications, and deployments to identify and resolve potential issues proactively.
Troubleshoot infrastructure and deployment issues and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution.
Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.


Security & Compliance
Integrate security best practices into CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application deployments.
Implement appropriate access controls, secrets management, and security configurations.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, organizational policies, security requirements, and data-privacy regulations.
Work closely with security and engineering teams to identify and mitigate infrastructure and deployment risks.



Good-to-Have:

Experience with additional CI/CD tools like Jenkins.
Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Puppet).



Required Skills & Qualifications



Educational Background
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field from a reputed institution.

About Vista Equity Partners


Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology- enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product Companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vistas presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.


Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.


About Amtech


Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technological organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.


Role Description


This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in a large, mature enterprise codebase and solving real-world operational problems. Success requires curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a complex environment. You'll work on software that supports corrugated manufacturing operations, including scheduling, production control, plant-floor interfaces, reporting, and system integrations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


1) Java Platform


Strong Core Java experience using modern language features (Java 17). Experience with multi-module Gradle builds. Solid understanding of Java EE technologies, including: Servlets
EJB 3 (Session and Entity Beans)
JPA with Hibernate
Container-managed transactions (JTA)



2) Application Server & Deployment


Experience deploying and troubleshooting applications on Apache TomEE/OpenEJB.
Familiarity with WAR/EAR packaging, data-source configuration, and container administration.



3) Data & Integration


Strong SQL Server skills, including: SQL development and optimization
Database schema design and analysis
Experience designing and consuming RESTful HTTP APIs. Working knowledge of JSON serialization libraries such as Jackson or Gson.

4) Development Environment




Windows-based development experience.
Comfortable working in a Windows-based development environment (the team primarily uses Eclipse).
Experience with PowerShell and Windows batch scripting for build, deployment, and operational tasks.
Proficient with Git and GitHub workflows.



SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS


Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus

Reporting: BIRT 4.19
Desktop UI development with Java Swing and SwingX. Experience designing manufacturing or industrial touchscreen user interfaces. Familiarity with transport layers: TCP/IP, Serial
Testing with JUnit 4.



Nice to Have:


Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash
Ideal candidates combine engineering depth with governance awareness
Industry certifications preferred, such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or AWS Security Specialty



Why Join Amtech


At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture.
